statement: Fix 0 < β < 1. Let J be a symmetric matrix with zero diagonal and independent entries Jij ∼ N(0, β2/n) for i < j, and let νJ (x) = Z−1 J exp (1 2xT Jx ) , x ∈ {−1, 1}n . There is a finite constant Cβ, depending only on β, such that PJ {VarνJ (f) ≤ CβDνJ (f) for every f : {−1, 1}n → R} −→ 1. Here DνJ is the unscaled sum of conditional variances. Consequently, the discrete-time heat-bath chain choosing one uniform site has spectral gap at least 1/(nCβ) with probability tending to one.
